    How to take this course

    • Click Next and Back at the bottom of the screen to move one screen at a time.
    • Use the course menu on the left to see every section. Sections you’ve visited show a ✓, and your current screen is highlighted. It stays open on the left at all times.
    • You can jump to any module at any time, forward or back. The Wrap-up unlocks after you’ve finished all four modules.
    • Nothing is scored, saved, or sent anywhere. If you refresh the page, the course starts over.
